notice.title: Uniform sizes and travel preferences moved to each project
notice.body: Productions now ask for your uniform sizes, seat, meal and home airport on each project you are rostered on, and keep them only for that project. Enter them on the project.

dietary.title: Dietary needs
dietary.description: What hospitality needs to know to feed you safely.
dietary.chosen: {count, plural, =0 {None chosen} one {# chosen} other {# chosen}}
dietary.allergiesHelp: Say how severe each one is, for example peanuts, anaphylaxis.

accessibility.title: Accessibility needs
accessibility.description: What an organization should plan for so you can work comfortably and leave safely.

travel.title: Loyalty programs
travel.description: Programs an organization can add to the travel it books for you.

passport.title: Passport
passport.description: Your passport number is stored encrypted. It stays masked everywhere until you reveal it, and every reveal is logged.
passport.name: Name as printed
passport.nameHelp: Exactly as it appears in the passport. Bookings must match it.
passport.numberHelp: Leave blank to keep the number on file.

contacts.title: Emergency contacts
contacts.description: People to call if something happens to you on site, in the order to call them. Up to five.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.phoneHelp: Include the country code for a number outside {region}.

names.title: Name parts
names.description: Optional. Your full name stays as you wrote it. These are used for formal address and sorting.

sharing.title: Sharing with engagements
sharing.description: An organization that engages you sees only the categories you share with that engagement, and only while it is open. You can change or revoke a share at any time.
sharing.none: You have no engagements to share with yet.
sharing.closed: This engagement is complete or canceled, so nothing is shared with it.

log.title: Access log
log.description: Every change you made, every share, and every time an organization viewed or revealed your details. Values are never logged.

actions.fieldsRemoved: Uniform sizes and travel preferences removed from your profile
actions.projectFactsExpired: Project details deleted after the engagement closed
actions.dietaryNeedsCounted: Counted your dietary needs for catering

org.title: Shared work details
org.description: What {name} shared with this engagement. Each view is logged where {name} can see it.
org.notShared: {name} has not shared any work details with this engagement.
org.hidden: Shared, but your role does not cover it.
org.contactNone: No verified email or phone yet.

medical.title: Medical
medical.description: Shown to you for on-site care. Each view is logged.

org.revealReasonHelp: Logged with the reveal, for example Booking the June flights.

errors.passport_number_format: A passport number has 5 to 20 letters and digits.
errors.passport_number_missing: No passport number is on file.
errors.passport_reveal_reason: Write why you need the passport number, in at least 10 characters.
errors.step_up_required: Verify with your second factor, then reveal the number.
errors.emergency_contact_limit: You can keep up to five emergency contacts. Remove one first.
errors.loyalty_program_limit: You can keep up to twenty loyalty programs. Remove one first.
errors.work_detail_share_not_yours: Only the person an engagement names can share or revoke its work details.
errors.work_detail_share_closed: This engagement is complete or canceled, so nothing more is shared with it.
errors.work_detail_share_categories: Choose at least one category, or revoke the share.
errors.work_detail_not_shared: The person has not shared their passport details with this engagement.
errors.org_read_only: This organization is canceled and read-only, so nothing more is shared with it.
errors.work_detail_field_moved: Uniform sizes and travel preferences are no longer kept on your profile. Enter them on each project you are rostered on.
errors.work_detail_category_retired: Uniform sizes are no longer shared from your profile. Enter them on the project.
errors.work_detail_share_contact_alone: Share your contact together with at least one other category.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number with its country code, for example +1 305 555 0142.
errors.invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.conflict: You already have this loyalty program.
errors.unexpected: That did not save. Try again.
errors.project_fact_not_yours: Only the person on this roster entry, or the company that rosters them, enters these details.
errors.roster_entry_declined: This roster entry was declined, so nothing more is entered on it.
errors.project_fact_closed: This engagement is complete or canceled, so its project details are closed.
errors.offering_not_offered: The project does not offer this, so it is not asked.
errors.project_fact_company_write_off: This project asks each person to enter their own details.
errors.project_fact_person_entered: The person entered these details themselves, so only they change them.
errors.airport_unknown: Choose an airport from the list.
errors.travel_dates_order: The day you travel home comes on or after the day you arrive.
errors.project_fact_empty: Give at least one detail before saving.
errors.project_fact_text_length: That text is too long. Shorten it and save again.
errors.shoe_size_format: A shoe size runs from 1 to 20 in half sizes.
errors.shoe_size_system_required: Give the shoe size with its sizing system.
errors.pants_measure_range: A waist runs from 20 to 70 inches and an inseam from 20 to 40.
errors.vehicle_fields_required: Give the make, model, plate and the region that issued it.
errors.plate_format: A plate is 1 to 10 letters and digits.
errors.plate_region_format: Give the region as a code such as US-FL, or the country code alone.

compass.offline: Your work details load when you are online.
compass.failed: Your work details did not load. Open your profile again to retry.

projectFacts.title: Project details
projectFacts.sentence: The travel, uniform and vehicle details this project asks of you. They stay on this engagement, never on your profile, and leave after the engagement closes.
projectFacts.none: This project asks for no travel, uniform or vehicle details.
projectFacts.reviewSentence: Here is what you entered. Go back to any step to change it.
projectFacts.lastDetailsNone: You have no earlier details of this kind.
projectFacts.lastDetailsFilled: Filled from your last details. Check them, then save.
projectFacts.readOnly: Entered by {name}. Only they change these details.
projectFacts.companyBanner: {name} will be notified of what you enter and can correct it.
projectFacts.airportSearch: Search by city, airport or code
projectFacts.airportNoMatch: No airport matches. Try the city or the three-letter code.

inboundAirport.label: Arriving at
inboundAirport.help: The airport you fly into for the project.

inboundOn.label: Arrival date
inboundOn.help: The day you travel to the project.

outboundAirport.label: Flying home from
outboundAirport.help: The airport you fly home from.

needsGroundTransport.label: I need a pickup on arrival

needsLodging.label: I need a room
needsLodging.help: Lodging for the nights you are on site.

seatPreference.label: Seat
seatPreference.help: Your preferred seat on the flight.

mealPreference.label: Meal preference
mealPreference.help: For the flight, up to 100 characters.

travelNotes.label: Notes for the travel desk
travelNotes.help: Anything else they should know, up to 500 characters.

shoeSizeSystem.label: Shoe sizing
shoeSizeSystem.help: The system your shoe size is in.

plate.label: License plate
plate.help: Letters and digits; spaces and hyphens are removed.

plateRegion.label: Plate region
plateRegion.help: Where the plate was issued, such as US-FL, or the country code alone.
